proposal: Extend existing query page predicate model with required >= and < for nonnullable stored Instant representation roots only; retain existing equal/optional equal/optional <= semantics. Do not add compound query-many, dynamic SQL or hostfilter.

For one field, permit exactly one >= lower and one < upper pair in either authored order; reject duplicate lower/upper, mixed equality/optional predicate on same field, nullable/none bound or field, Text/Time/presentation fields, mismatched nominal types and unknown fields. Require same typed field nominal context with existing compatibility rules; no implicit Text/CalendarDate conversion.

Use existing where/and: clauses and page/cursor/projection shape. Bound operands use existing checked expressions, evaluated once per query operation; two required Instant parameters follow existing typed adapter encoding and PostgreSQL casts. Existing ordering, unique cursor, page-size bounds and plus-one, policy scope and first/continuation SQL guarantees remain.

Keep generated index scope based on equality/visibility keys plus existing order; new range predicates cannot become equality scope facts or implicitly weaken policy. All predicate facts/operators enter checked persistence/canonical metadata and source/digest validation; do not omit them from approval subject or formatter.

Actual generated stored create plus actual generated page handler receives bounds from compiler-owned temporal.day_bounds for London23/24/25h. Include before-start/start/end-minus1ms/end/after-end, otherbucket, equal-time cursor continuation; prove start included/end excluded and no DATE(timestamp) or hostfiltered result substitution. This proves generated temporal runtime plus typed query boundary; source-level day_bounds callable exposure remains separately honest.
